characters.name: The Huntsman (Skytteren)
characters.prompt: A Norwegian huntsman dressed in the rustic attire of the 1400–1850 period with a simple flintlock rifle, wearing woolen garments and leather boots; he stands in a dense Nordic forest setting, appearing determined but grounded in the rugged wilderness.

characters.name: The Snipe (Myrsnipe)
characters.prompt: A slender, long-billed bird with soft brown and white plumage, set against a marshy Norwegian landscape. The snipe shows protectiveness and concern, reflecting a motherly figure for her small chicks.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: An illustration set in an old, misty Norwegian forest during the 1400–1850 era. A modestly dressed huntsman stands on a lush green path, carrying a simple flintlock rifle, facing a small snipe bird fluttering anxiously beside him. The scenery features tall pines and mossy undergrowth, highlighting the quiet tension as the huntsman contemplates the snipe’s words about her beautiful offspring.
modernMainImagePrompt: A contemporary scene in today’s Norway: a hiker in modern outdoor gear pausing on a wetland boardwalk where a small snipe is perched. He holds a modern camera instead of a rifle, capturing the bird’s stressed reaction as she tries to protect her chicks beside peat moss and reeds. The image conveys a modern interpretation of cherishing one’s loved ones.
childMainImagePrompt: A bright and friendly cartoon-style illustration of a gentle Norwegian hunter in olden clothes, smiling as he meets a cute, wide-eyed snipe with tiny, adorable chicks in a sunny clearing. Everything looks soft and inviting, with colorful flowers and playful forest animals in the background, suitable for a five-year-old audience.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Et moderne norsk skoglandskap med en jeger i gammeldags klær som møter en snipe og hennes pinglete, men sjarmerende unger ved en liten myr. Bildet viser dem i en rolig atmosfære, der suna skinner over trærne, og viser fortellingens enkle poeng om at alle elsker sine egne barn mest.
englishMainImagePrompt: A vivid illustration of an old-time Norwegian forest (1400–1850) where a humble huntsman, dressed in rustic attire and carrying a simple rifle, meets a concerned snipe bird with her young chicks. The soft light filters through tall pines onto the mossy ground, capturing the timeless lesson of a parent’s love for its children.
